reason: The hour or two a day I lose to DMs is real and $147 is nothing next to a single retainer, but there is not one result or case study, and I would be putting my own Instagram on the line for it. I might poke at the trial, but I would not leave a card on it and let it bill.
objection: No reviews, no case studies, so how do I know it actually books calls? Three days will not show me a booked call, and after that it bills and payments are final. And if automated sending gets my account flagged, I lose my main way of finding clients.
would_change_my_mind: A real agency owner's numbers (DMs sent, replies, calls booked) I can check, or a trial long enough to run a week of real outreach, or a refund window after the first charge.
